name: opdf
description: Offline-first PDF desktop app (web-first dev, desktop runtime)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @opdf/core && npm run build -w @opdf/web && npm run build -w @opdf/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @opdf/core && npm run typecheck -w @opdf/web && npm run typecheck -w @opdf/desktop
